id: title:benben:skip backfills for non ready warehouses

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse compatibility and recovery checks to backfill sensor scheduling, preventing scheduling of work against warehouses not reporting ready state.
review.reason: The change implements warehouse readiness filtering and discovery, including authentication and error handling, while retaining original APIs. This supports warehouse compatibility and recovery, allowing the system to skip provisioning or scheduling for warehouses not reporting ready. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on observed implementation and checks, not on unverified outcomes or adoption. The tier is assigned only on observed implementation and checks.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or benefit claims are supported; tier is assigned only on observed implementation and checks.

observations.behavior: Adds warehouse readiness filtering and its own discovery API, while retaining the original team-listing and warehouse-listing APIs.
observations.code_quote: Backfill sensors only schedule teams with backfills enabled in a managed warehouse that reports `state: ready`.
observations.posthog_connection: Backfill sensor scheduling and warehouse compatibility. The README documents that the sensor will not schedule work for warehouses not reporting ready, and will not schedule work if the warehouse or team listing is unavailable.

observations.behavior: Adds warehouse discovery and readiness filtering, including authentication and error handling.
observations.code_quote: return [row for row in data["warehouses"] if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("state") == "ready"]
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse compatibility and recovery. The implementation fetches warehouses, authenticates, and filters to those reporting ready, returning None on failure. This supports the README's claim that the sensor skips provisioning, failed, deleting, deleted, and resharding warehouses.

observations.behavior: Changes warehouse listing to warehouse readiness, and team listing to warehouse readiness, while retaining the original warehouse-listing and team-listing APIs.
observations.code_quote: return [team for team in enabled_teams if team.organization_id in ready_organization_ids]
observations.posthog_connection: Backfill scheduling and warehouse compatibility. The implementation now filters teams to those whose warehouses are ready, supporting the README's claim that the sensor skips warehouses not reporting ready.
